title: Share P104 correction collectors across incidence groups
head: 78e7e4c1032a3f2bce8dae4f3f2bf30ac924b050
body:
PR2460's three-target P104 construction pays separate extra collectors for dependent incidence groups. This follows its cross-group handoff: the triple group's two dirty carriers also provide the independent rows needed by the two pair-group shears. That saves **two helpers, four transports and 18 boundary-rank units with no additional ADDs**.

Combining the new cross-group step with CubeJerry's exact PR2504 late-exclusive component gives a complete finite word with **90 helpers, 517 ADDs, 279 nested transports and 810 ZERO-to-FULL boundary ranks**. Y0/Y1/Y2 become yt+xt; the other 101 targets retain their original G/2 updates. All original sources and dirty helpers are restored; the endpoint is checked on all 370 independent input columns, totaling 136,900 coefficients. A separate 92-helper cross-only control distinguishes the new saving from PR2504's credited late-acquisition saving. The package checks the actual exclusive source set and retains that component literally; it does not assume that PR2496's Y2-only chains compose here.

The key invertible shear maps (B,T) to (B+T,-B). Its two outputs supply one pair of targets, while the third triple-group carrier supplies Y2. The proof covers legal common frames, initial arbitrary-dirty compensation and FULL-frame inverse restoration. The added profile is `146 H1 + 36 H2 + 7 H3 + H4 + 8 H5 + 40 H6 + 41 H7`. The separated 94-helper lower bound is not contradicted: its no-cross-group-mixing premise is explicitly changed. No unrestricted 90-helper minimum is claimed.

Validation: registered optimized **CPython 3.12.7** replay, complete literal regeneration, five full baseline/candidate replays, eight semantic faults, equivalent-frame positive control, credited separate dense-dyadic interpreter and six Git-free export/boundary test groups pass. **CPython 3.14.5** optimized primary replay also passes. A separate AI reviewer independently reconstructed C=I-G/2 and interpreted only the added operations against the original frame chronology, importing no candidate executable; all 144 nonzero correction coefficients, dirty restoration, exact invoice and late captures at cuts 0/669/842 agree. No human independent review, proof assistant or hosted CI pass is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-cross-group-collectors
```

Default replay is read-only, Git-free and network-free. Sources, proof, literal words, complete receipts, Git/SHA256 pins and open questions are in `research/p104-cross-group-collectors/`.

Boundary ranks are not hosted recursive excess costs. The original private-copy/nonzero-discard contract remains inherited. New native phases/scalar-address lowering, backward orientation, global owners/idle/residual charges, physical precision/tape, all-size admission and the remaining 101 corrections are open.
